request_id.description: Chosen by the client, unique among the collection subscriptions open on this socket. Every frame about the subscription carries it.

robot_id.description: Only the records of this robot, in a collection that belongs to robots.

filter.description: Only records matching this filter are delivered, with the grammar of the `filter` of the record list but as an object, not JSON text. The whole frame is at most 16,384 bytes, which fits the longest filter allowed.

description: Subscribes to the changes of the records of one collection.
